name: link
description: Structural links define how structural nodes attach to zones or other structural objects. Link properties and attachment modes control normal/shear transfer and sliding behavior.

notes: 'structure link property' is followed by a DOF selector, then per-DOF sub-keywords. FLAC3D 9.7 live enumeration: DOF selectors are x, y, z, rotation-x, rotation-y, rotation-z (no bare 'rotation' in 3D); per-DOF sub-keywords are area, cohesion, for-structure-type, friction, gap, stiffness.
FLAC2D nodes have 3 DOFs: x, y, rotation. FLAC3D uses the 6-DOF selector set above.

'structure link' subcommands (FLAC3D 9.7 live enumeration): attach, create, delete, dynamic-damping, group, hide, history, list, property, select, slide, tolerance-contact, tolerance-node, tolerance-slide.

Live FLAC2D 9 (2026-08-13): DOF selectors are exactly x / y / rotation; per-DOF sub-keywords are RICHER than 3D: area, cohesion, cohesion-table, confinement-table, for-structure-type, friction, friction-table, gap, incremental-confinement-flag, perimeter, stiffness (11 vs the 6 in FLAC3D 9.7).

concepts.name: attachment
concepts.description: Defines the target object and degree-of-freedom relationship for a structural node.

concepts.name: link model
concepts.description: Defines the mechanical response used by a link in each degree of freedom.

concepts.name: sliding
concepts.description: Controls whether the attachment location can migrate during large-strain motion.

workflow_hints: Most structure creation commands create required links automatically.
Use explicit link commands when you need nondefault attachment behavior.
List links after structure creation when troubleshooting unexpected support-grid interaction.
